About Our Bag Cleaning Service

Handbags and everyday bags pick up grime on handles, bases and linings that a wipe won't shift. Cleanzit cleans leather handbags, cloth, canvas and jute bags, suitcases and wallets, using a method suited to each material.

Cloth bags start at ₹150+, handbags at ₹200+ and leather handbags at ₹300+, with doorstep pickup across Bhopal.

What's included

  • Inspection of material, hardware and lining
  • Material-appropriate cleaning
  • Packed and delivered within 3 days

Bag care tips

  • Empty every pocket before handing over a bag.
  • Store leather bags stuffed with paper, inside a cloth dust bag, away from direct sun.
  • Wipe handles regularly — they collect the most dirt and oil.
